lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular local maxima are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. Four prominent centroids form a trapezoidal arrangement on the mid-lateral flank between the pectoral and first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a localized shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-to-moderate density of high-luminance blobs is distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized toward the leading edge and the base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region exhibits a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, high-frequency luminance points compared to the larger, more spaced macro-pattern of the lateral flank.
